basic_details.job_title: YISU IT Executive Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Young India Skills University, Telangana (YISU) is hiring 1 IT Executive on a purely contractual basis for one year, extendable, with posting at YISU, Hyderabad. The monthly consolidated remuneration is ₹45,000 to 50,000/-. Candidates need a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science / Information Technology / Electronics or any equivalent degree (B.Sc / B.Tech / BCA) and at least 2 years of relevant experience. Applications are made online through the university's careers page, and the last date is 28 October 2026.

how_to_apply: Go to the YISU careers page at https://yisu.in/careers/.
Open the link (Apply now) provided with Advertisement No. Advt/CA-NT/2026/03 and complete the online application.
Submit the application, fully filled in, with the required documents, by 28 October 2026.
Take a printout of the acknowledgment of the online application and keep it for future reference.
Applications received after the deadline or incomplete in any respect will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: About YISU
content_sections.text: Young India Skills University (YISU) was set up in Hyderabad under the Young India Skills University, Telangana (Public-Private Partnership) Act, 2024 (Act No. 13 of 2024 of the Government of Telangana) to bridge the gap between industry needs and academic offerings. It runs on a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model in which the Telangana Government and industry leaders work together so that the curriculum matches real-world demands.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is open to eligible Indian citizens. It is unreserved, but the notice says candidates from reserved categories are encouraged to apply. The notice also lists the knowledge expected for the post: Proficiency in MS Office, system administration, printer/network setup, and troubleshooting hardware/software issues. Knowledge of LAN/WAN configuration, basic networking protocols, and OS installation (Windows/Linux). Familiarity with email configuration, antivirus support, and data backup systems. Good communication skills and ability to assist non-technical users. Ability to handle, update, and maintain website. The prescribed qualifications and experience are minimum requirements. Meeting them does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called for selection. Candidates must check their own eligibility against the prescribed qualifications and experience. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, see the official notification.

rows.as_printed_in_the_notice: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science / Information Technology / Electronics or any equivalent degree (B.Sc / B.Tech / BCA) from a recognized University / Institution.

Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in IT support, system and website maintenance, networking, or hardware/software troubleshooting in a Government, Semi-Government, University or reputed private institution.
Not exceeding 45 years as on the last date of application (28 October 2026).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The IT Executive gets a monthly consolidated remuneration of ₹45,000 to 50,000/-. The engagement is on a purely contractual basis for one year and may be extended based on performance and institutional requirements. It gives no right to a regular appointment and no right to claim regularization or absorption in the University. The University reserves the right to offer a position with a lower designation and pay, depending on the candidate's suitability.

content_sections.heading: YISU IT Executive Job Description
content_sections.text: The key responsibilities, as printed in the notice: Provide technical support for computers, printers, LAN/Wi-Fi, and AV equipment. Assist in installation, configuration, and troubleshooting of hardware and software. Manage user accounts, email setup, and provide day-to-day IT support to faculty, staff, and administration. Coordinate with vendors for IT infrastructure maintenance and AMC services. Maintain inventory of IT assets and provide documentation and reports. Support during university events, meetings, and online sessions. Perform any other IT-related tasks as assigned by the University authorities. Handle, update, and maintain University website and data.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for YISU IT Executive
content_sections.text: Applications received after the deadline or incomplete in any respect will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview. The University reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates based on qualifications and experience. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email and/or mobile phone to appear for the Written Test / Personal Interaction, which will be held at YISU, Hyderabad. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection process.
